caveats:
Administrative level 2 feature Kartala (KM29) is an unpopulated active volcano.

Population statistics are available for administrative levels 0, 1, 2, 4, and 5.  Administrative levels 4 (locality) and 5 (village) P-codes are not certain to be correct and the population data do not roll up to administrative level 3 (commune). Administrative level 3 data are unavailable.

name: cod-ab-com
notes:
Comoros administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01.  
  
This dataset is structured into 3 levels:  
- Admin 1: 3   
- Admin 2: 17   
- Admin 3: 55   
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 30 October 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 05 December 2019: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 05 December 2019: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 05 December 2019: boundaries created by the source  
  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
